messages:
maya: quick async standup — very short
what I did: finished the lightweight rollout spec + test plan (link: https://redwood.docs/rollouts/kv-cache)
blocked on: kv-cache e2e is flaky in dedicated infra, failing on memory spikes 
today: merge UI PR, cut canary build, get infra green for e2e
notes: PR needs a tiny text tweak (see below) and a manual canary trigger.

maya: repro command i've been using:
```bash
# run a 30s KV cache stress with 8 clients
./scripts/stress_kvcache --clients=8 --duration=30 --seed=42
```

simon: taking the infra unblock. saw the heap growth earlier — likely a cache eviction edge-case.
I can repro locally, will try the stress_kvcache command now. ping me if you want me to rollback the canary. @maya

jamal: PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821
summary: UI copy + rollout toggle + metrics hooks. needs an approval from infra + product. small change in header copy (2 words).
@maya @sarah can you quick-look the copy? :eyes:

sarah: checked the copy, ok with the wording. left one alt-text suggestion in the PR comment. design is fine with canary visuals. :white_check_mark:

eli: quick prioritization note — i recommend we ship the canary gating first and push the analytics metric expansion to milestone X+1. customers are asking for reliable fallback logic more than extra metrics right now.
If infra says unblock by EOD we go canary, otherwise we delay and ship next week.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: Canary window opens at 2024-06-20T11:30:00Z for team=product, env=dedicated. Auto-rollback on error threshold 5% :rocket:

simon: update — stress_kvcache reproduces OOM when client bursts align with eviction window. suspect race in kv-evict. pushing a diagnostic build (tag: kv-dump-171845) and will attach logs.
```
EPOCH: 171845
ERR: eviction failed: buffer overflow
STACK: ...
```

maya: thanks @simon — assigning you as infra owner for this thread. Jamal, can you hold the PR merge until simon confirms the diagnostic build? if simon greenlights, we do the manual canary and watch the metric set.

jamal: ack — will hold merge. leaving a comment on the PR to mark blocked-by: infra.

maya: one last ask — if anyone has bandwidth, pls skim the rollout test checklist under the spec (section 3). a fast pair review will speed things up. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

simon: will post results here in ~45m. if it's a small race i'll push a hotfix branch.

maya: appreciated. tag me for canary start. :thumbsup:
